paper_title: Updated constraints on axion-like particles from temporal information in supernova SN1987A gamma-ray data
suggested_experiment_name: SN1987A SMM ALP-photon conversion (this work, lambda_P)
notes: Paper updates SN1987A gamma-ray limits on ALP-photon coupling using SMM/GRS data. Two regimes: ALP conversion in Galactic magnetic field (low mass ~1e-11 to 1e-8 eV, g~6.5e-12 GeV^-1 at 95% CL, improved by factor 1.4 with temporal info) and ALP decays (keV-GeV masses). Data points are approximate reads off Figures 2/3; benchmark values from text: ma=1e-10 eV, gaγ=6.55e-12 GeV^-1 (conversion) and ma=1 MeV, gaγ=2.26e-11 GeV^-1 (decay) are disfavored benchmarks, not exactly the limit. Exclusion limit values are approximate. This is an astrophysical (stellar/SN) bound, not a DM haloscope, so no DM density. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.8, 31)) | Vision: Left panel of Figure 3.
